InferredLabel.description:
One name the server guessed for one clip (KRI-207), so the creator can correct it.

``clip_index`` is the clip's zero-based position in the plan's own clip order (what
the creator sees as "clip 4" is index 3); ``media_id`` is its stable identity.
InferredLabel.title: InferredLabel

RequirementReceipt.description:
One deterministic outcome per Creative Brief requirement (KRI-188).

``inferred`` lists values the server guessed rather than read from the
creator or the footage (for example a landmark name), so the client can show
them and let the creator correct one. ``inferred_labels`` is the same list with
the clip each guess belongs to (additive, KRI-207); ``inferred`` stays for
clients that only read strings.
RequirementReceipt.title: RequirementReceipt

CarouselMomentEditRequest.description:
Partial carousel-moment config for the carousel editor panel.

All fields optional — an omitted field keeps the variant's persisted
value; the top-level `EditVariantRequest.carousel_moment` itself is what
carries the absent/null/dict tri-state (see `dispatch_edit_variant`):
omitting `carousel_moment` entirely leaves the moment unchanged, an
explicit top-level `null` removes it, and a `CarouselMomentEditRequest`
body here partial-merges over whatever's persisted (present keys win,
absent keys keep). Enum/range validation happens in
`dispatch_edit_variant`, matching every other loosely-typed field on
`EditVariantRequest` (font_family, effect, text_color, ...).
CarouselMomentEditRequest.title: CarouselMomentEditRequest

EditorCaptionAppearance.description: Explicit native-editor appearance; missing values retain legacy renders.
EditorCaptionAppearance.title: EditorCaptionAppearance

EditorCommitBackgroundMusic.description:
Full replacement background bed for editor commits.

``track_id=None`` or ``enabled=false`` clears the bed. When a track is set,
the persisted renderer contract remains ``smart_music_treatment``.
EditorCommitBackgroundMusic.title: EditorCommitBackgroundMusic

EditorCommitMix.description:
Editor mix section. `music_level` maps onto the existing per-variant `mix`
semantics (voice/bed balance — voiceover variants only). `original_level` is
persisted for round-tripping but not yet honored by the render pipeline.
EditorCommitMix.title: EditorCommitMix

EditorStateIn.description:
The editor's CURRENT UNSAVED state, sent with a chat turn.

A lane present is the client's full current value; absent equals the saved variant.
A present-but-empty ``lanes`` is still authoritative: "no unsaved edits".
The server never recomputes a hash; ``client_state_id`` is echoed verbatim.
EditorStateIn.title: EditorStateIn

EditorStateLanes.description: ``EditorCommitRequest`` as a turn's editor state (adds list caps).
EditorStateLanes.title: EditorStateLanes

EditorStateTimelineSlot.description:
A Save timeline row plus the media identity of an UNSAVED added clip.

A saved row's media is recoverable from ``clip_index`` against the persisted
sources; a clip the creator just added is not in them yet, so the client names it
here (all optional, ignored by the Save route which uses ``TimelineSlotEdit``).
EditorStateTimelineSlot.title: EditorStateTimelineSlot

LookAdjustments.description:
User-tunable controls for the two cinematic source looks.

Strength scales the authored grade. Warmth and contrast are signed trims
around that grade; grain and vignette are absolute amounts so either can
be removed without weakening the color treatment.
LookAdjustments.title: LookAdjustments

MediaBlock.description: User-authored image/video layer composed below text and captions.
MediaBlock.title: MediaBlock

MediaTransform.description: Shared fullscreen transform mirrored by the editor preview.
MediaTransform.title: MediaTransform

argument_schema.title: ApplyEditorOpsArguments

tools.name: draft.apply_editor_ops

CreativeStrategy.description:
Bounded editorial choices selected by the orchestrator.

``intro_hook`` remains an advisory concept for backwards compatibility.
``opening_title`` is the separate, confirmed copy contract: when present it
is burned verbatim (after the renderer's normal surrounding trim), rather
than being sent back through an LLM.  The optional typography fields use
the same font/color vocabulary as the authoritative TextElement schema.

closing_title.description: Confirmed exact closing/end-card copy; never an LLM-generated suggestion.
closing_title.title: Closing Title

image_layout.description: Confirmed image-only layout. supporting_card shows the full image; fullscreen fills the canvas with a cover crop.
image_layout.title: Image Layout

intro_hook.description: Opening concept shown for creative approval; never treated as trusted or burned verbatim by the renderer
intro_hook.title: Intro Hook

opening_title.description: Confirmed exact opening title copy; never an LLM-generated suggestion.
opening_title.title: Opening Title

opening_title_duration_s.description: Confirmed seconds the opening title holds, from the creator's words.
opening_title_duration_s.title: Opening Title Duration S

shot_labels.description: Confirmed exact per-shot label copy in on-screen order; each label is burned verbatim on its own shot and never rewritten by a specialist.
shot_labels.title: Shot Labels

text_color.description: Confirmed intro color (#RRGGBB or a supported color alias).
text_color.title: Text Color

CreativeStrategy.title: CreativeStrategy

LicensedSfxIntent.description: A bounded request for the funny-moments licensed SFX treatment.
LicensedSfxIntent.title: LicensedSfxIntent

MixedMediaTimingProfile.description:
Typed timing intent for mixed photo/video edits.

The profile is optional so old proposals keep their exact timing behavior.
Values describe preferences, not permission to exceed source duration.
MixedMediaTimingProfile.title: MixedMediaTimingProfile

MontageAudioPlan.description: Generic audio intent for a source-aware montage timeline.
MontageAudioPlan.title: MontageAudioPlan

MontageCadenceConstraint.description: Exact creator-authored source cadence for a fast montage.
MontageCadenceConstraint.title: MontageCadenceConstraint
